why: The shading moves anticlockwise around the four squares: top-left, then bottom-left, then bottom-right, then top-right. Each square is first half shaded (left half), and in the next figure it becomes fully shaded. So C must have top-left and bottom-left full, and bottom-right with its left half shaded: option 2. Option 1 shades the right half instead, so it is wrong.
trick: Follow the half-shaded square: it shows where the shading moves next, and it always fills from the left half.
note: Hatched shading drawn as flat grey.
